# 知乎 (Zhihu)

> > China's leading knowledge-sharing and Q&A platform, offering curated daily digests and community-driven content across diverse topics.

Zhihu is a Chinese question-and-answer platform where users share knowledge, insights, and expertise. The platform features both community Q&A content and editorial products like 知乎日报 (Zhihu Daily), which curates high-quality answers and articles for daily consumption.

## Key Topics

- 知乎日报 (Zhihu Daily)
- 知乎 (Zhihu platform)
- Knowledge sharing
- Q&A content
- Daily digest
- Chinese content
- Reading platform
- Mobile app
- Compilation
- Community-driven content
- 百年孤独 (One Hundred Years of Solitude)
- 中国 (China)
- Cultural topics

## Daily Digest

- [知乎日报 - 每天 3 次，每次 7 分钟](https://daily.zhihu.com/?k=compilation&top): Zhihu Daily: curated knowledge digest with 21-min avg reading time
